verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents generating API credentials under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, with configurable permissions and an optional expiry date. Endpoint references name specific permissions, such as "View roles in account" and "Monitor and unmonitor customers", which indicates fine-grained permissions exist for least-privilege scoping. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that credentials can be restricted to individual endpoint-level permissions (vs. roles), any agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
